source_refs.note: Exercise 9.2, Question 6: book page 176 (PDF 181); constant of S(t) overprinted (+5 / -6); key entry 7 on PDF 307 gives 45, which needs +5; checked with sympy and the solution book (PDF 863-864).

blocks.prompt: 6. Consider a signal represented by the polynomial \(S(t) = 3t^2 - 2t + 5\) [the last term is overprinted in the book; \(+5\) is the reading the answer key implies]. If the input to the system is \(t = 4\), find the remainder by using remainder theorem.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh Remainder Theorem hi hai, bas \(x\) ki jagah \(t\) likha hai: \(S(t)\) ko \(t - 4\) se divide karein to remainder \(S(4)\) hota hai.
Find kya karna hai? Ek number, remainder. Kitab mein aakhri term saaf nahi chhapa; hum \(+5\) lete hain, kyunke answer key ka jawab isi se aata hai (neeche box dekhein).
Plan: \(t = 4\) rakhein, phir division se tasdeeq.
Imtihan mein aisa dhundla term mile to ghabrana nahi; tareeqa wahi rehta hai. Hum imaandari se batate hain ke kaunsi reading li aur kyun.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(S(t) = 3t^2 - 2t + 5\) (constant \(+5\) parha gaya), input \(t = 4\).
Humein find karna hai: \(S(t)\) ko \(t - 4\) se divide karne par remainder.
Tareeqa: Remainder Theorem: remainder \(= S(4)\). Variable ka naam \(x\) ho ya \(t\), koi farq nahi padta; rule bilkul wahi hai. Signal processing mein waqt (time) ke liye aksar \(t\) likhte hain, bas.
Yeh sawal kahta hai "by using remainder theorem", is liye examiner chahta hai ke aap pehle likhein "Remainder \(= S(4)\)" aur phir value nikalein. Sirf jawab likh dena kaafi nahi; theorem ka naam aur pehli line zaroor likhein, is par marks milte hain.

Synthetic division se tasdeeq (\(t - 4\) se)
Coefficients \(3,\ -2,\ 5\), \(a = 4\):
3 neeche utarein; \(3 \times 4 = 12\), \(-2 + 12 = 10\);
\(10 \times 4 = 40\), \(5 + 40 = 45\).
\[\text{Quotient} = 3t + 10\]
\[\text{Remainder} = 45 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Division bhi wahi 45 deti hai. Ulta check: \((t - 4)(3t + 10) + 45 = 3t^2 + 10t - 12t - 40 + 45 = 3t^2 - 2t + 5\).
Synthetic division mein yahan sirf teen coefficients hain kyunke \(S(t)\) degree 2 ka hai, is liye quotient degree 1 ka (\(3t + 10\)) aaya. Quotient ki degree hamesha ek kam hoti hai.

Agar constant \(-6\) hota
\[S(4) = 48 - 8 - 6 = 34\]
Kyun: Tareeqa constant badalne se nahi badalta, sirf aakhri number badalta hai. Chunke answer key 45 deti hai, is liye kitab ka maqsad \(+5\) hi tha. Imtihan mein agar saaf sawal mile to bilkul yahi steps karne hain.
blocks.final_answer: Remainder \(= S(4) = 45\) (\(S(t) = 3t^2 - 2t + 5\) ke saath, jo answer key se zahir hota hai).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein \(S(t) = 3t^2 - 2t \ldots\) ka aakhri term ek dusre ke upar chhapa hua hai: do nishan aapas mein mil gaye hain, aur \(+5\) bhi parha ja sakta hai aur \(-6\) bhi. Sirf chhapai dekh kar faisla nahi ho sakta. Answer key (PDF 307) mein is sawal ka jawab number 7 par "45" hai, aur \(S(4) = 45\) sirf \(+5\) se aata hai (\(-6\) se 34 aata). Is liye humne \(+5\) le kar hal kiya, kyunke key yahi batati hai.
